goal: Scan screen script (S7 frontend, Board gate 189): scan.js reveals the log lines one after another and opens the first workspace by itself.

acceptance_criteria.text: app/static/js/scan.js (served locally, deferred from scan.html) hides all .scan-log li on load and reveals one every min(350, 2500/n) ms, so the last line shows within 2.5 s; #open-workspace is visible from the start; after the last line it calls location.assign with #open-workspace's href (nothing when href is '/')

Playwright test (tests/test_scan_page.py): after an upload the page lands on /scan, line 2 appears later than line 1 (about 0.35 s apart), all lines are shown within 2.5 s plus tolerance, then the URL becomes /datasets/<first id>; with no JS all lines are in the HTML
With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the lines still appear in turn but have no fade/transition (computed transition-duration 0s); the scan page makes no request to any host except the app
CSS for .scan-log in databoot.css is used as the Designer wrote it (docs/DESIGN.md 'Round 7'); any change stays within the file's round 7 block
Moves acceptance items AC-78, AC-86 forward
